{
  "phoneNote": "The bakery styling is distinctive, but the tall contact header pushes the bread photo low in the first screen, and the product list breaks a word mid-word.",
  "desktopNote": "The warm palette, expressive typography and prominent bread photography work well, but the oversized contact number overwhelms the lower-page hierarchy.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 4,

    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 5,
    "spacing": 4,
    "clutter": 4,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Compact the phone header to one logo/menu row, rely on the fixed bar for call and directions, and add a readable location line near the hero heading so the bread photo appears higher.",
    "Rework phone product rows so names wrap only between words; place prices on a separate line when needed and remove dotted leaders on narrow screens.",
    "Reduce the desktop contact number substantially and tighten the contact section so the address, opening hours and email receive comparable visual attention."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Phone, product list: “Polnozrnate” breaks mid-word into “Polnozrnat” and “e žemlje”."
  ]
}
